evidence_tree.command: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
evidence_tree.note: A stray file 'syndra.txt' (mtime 7 minutes before this run) was present in the scratch parent and is NOT part of the git-archive export. It was not used as evidence; every quote below is from data/ or docs/math-foundations.md inside the export.

sources_quoted.quote: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.
Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.

Active: Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit. | Passive: Dark Sphere's cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of ability haste. [Ability Haste 10/20/30]

Q Dark Sphere cd {values:[7,7,7,7,7], affectedByCdr:false}; W Force of Will cd [12,11,10,9,8] affectedByCdr:true; E Scatter the Weak cd [15,15,15,15,15] affectedByCdr:true; R Unleashed Power cd [120,100,80] affectedByCdr:true

Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed *and* no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it *starts* within the window (`_schedule_shared_casts`). ... the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order.

Ability haste (`effective_cooldown`) | `cd' = cd*100/(100+AH)` | EXACT | R casts exactly once per timed fight (model constraint, documented)  ...  Ability rotation casts (`_schedule_shared_casts`, `_compute_ability_rotation`) ... R single-cast

E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage), R sphere count (r_spheres). All five slots modeled with sourced numbers.

step_1_scenario_parameter.claim: The '60' in 'syndra_custom_order_60' is the Transcendent splinter count, not a fight length or ability-haste value.
step_1_scenario_parameter.why: 60 is one of exactly four splinter thresholds carried in the cached wiki text (40 Q charges [S1], 60 W true damage [S2], 80 E scatter/slow, 100 R execute; 120 = max stacks). data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json [S7] confirms 'splinters' is a modeled option with those thresholds. 60 is the natural boundary value to pin. This is the one assumption in the chain and is flagged in residual_risk below; the arithmetic in step 3 shows the conclusion holds for any splinters value >= 40.

effective_cooldowns_at_R_rank_3_and_0_ex.Q Dark Sphere: 7 s base, affectedByCdr=false [S4]; R's passive grants Dark Sphere 30 ability haste at rank 3 [S3] -> 7 * 100/130 = 5.3846 s
effective_cooldowns_at_R_rank_3_and_0_ex.R Unleashed Power: 80 s at rank 3 [S4], and the engine model casts R exactly once per fight [S6]

same_check_at_60_ability_haste_for_robus.Q: 3.68 s (if external haste applied) or 5.38 s (if only R's passive applies)

step_2_which_slots_can_occupy_the_5th_ca.conclusion: Under the shared-timeline rule [S5], every ability is off cooldown at t=0, so the opening block of casts is exactly the scenario's cast order, one cast per sourced cast time (Q/W castTime 'none', E 0.25 s, R 0.25 s) -- the whole opener starts inside the first ~0.5 s. The first *recast* cannot occur before ~5.0-5.4 s, and it is Q (or W), never R: R's cooldown is 50-80 s and it is single-cast by model constraint [S6]. Therefore cast_timeline[4] is Unleashed Power if and only if the opening block contains five casts; if the opener contains only four, index 4 is necessarily the earliest recast, which is Dark Sphere.

step_3_does_the_opener_contain_five_cast.rule: S1: at 40+ Splinters of Wrath Syndra stocks a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.
step_3_does_the_opener_contain_five_cast.at_splinters_60: 60 >= 40, so the charge system is live and Syndra holds up to 2 Dark Sphere charges. Two Dark Sphere casts are legal back to back with no cooldown wait -- this is the 'Q2 slot' the cached audit records [S7]. The castable opening set is therefore {Q, Q(charge), W, E, R} = 5 casts, not 4.
step_3_does_the_opener_contain_five_cast.mana_check: Level-18 mana = 480 + 40 * 17 * (0.7025 + 0.0175*17) = 480 + 680 = 1160 [S8]. Opener cost at ranks 5/5/5/3 = Q 60 + Q 60 + W 100 + E 50 + R 100 = 370 < 1160. Mana does not gate the fifth cast.
step_3_does_the_opener_contain_five_cast.R_placement: R grabs 'up to 4 nearby live ones' and its damage scales from a 240-base 3-sphere floor to a 560-base 7-sphere ceiling at rank 1 [S3], so R is correct only after the sphere generators have fired; the module tracks this as the r_spheres option [S7]. R last in the opener is both the damage-maximizing and the game-legal placement, and it is the only placement consistent with the R-single-cast model constraint [S6].

independent_computation.result: Opening block = Dark Sphere, Dark Sphere (charge), Force of Will, Scatter the Weak, Unleashed Power. Index 4 = 'Unleashed Power'. The old value 'Dark Sphere' is exactly what a four-cast opener (charge-less Q) produces, where index 4 falls through to the first Q recast at t = 5.38 s -- i.e. the old timeline silently dropped the 40+ splinter Dark Sphere charge that S1 grants at splinters = 60.

residual_risk: The scenario tuple itself lives outside the permitted evidence tree (scripts/ and tests/ were not read), so the custom cast order and the meaning of the '60' suffix were reconstructed from the cached data rather than read directly. The cooldown arithmetic in step 2 is order-independent and rules R out of every slot except the opening block; the verdict therefore rests only on the opener containing five casts, which S1 guarantees for any splinters value >= 40.
verdict_statement: new_value_correct -- 'Unleashed Power' at fights/manual_target/cast_timeline[4]/name is the value the cached wiki rules and the documented shared-timeline model produce.
